title: Healthcare Analytics Intelligence Workbench
subtitle: Business-to-technology blueprint for healthcare analytics across FHIR, HCDM and HCF

stakeholders.interest: Population health, clinical outcomes, quality metrics, care-gap closure
Cost per episode, payer mix, revenue cycle, value-based contracts
Bed utilization, OR utilization, appointment scheduling, length of stay
Adverse events, hospital-acquired infections, medication errors, accreditation
Risk adjustment, prior authorization, fraud, network performance
Personal health record, appointment booking, telehealth, wellness insights

valueChain.name: Patient Identification & Engagement
valueChain.description: Capture patient demographics, identifiers, consent, insurance eligibility and preferred channels of engagement.

valueChain.name: Care Delivery & Documentation
valueChain.description: Record encounters, diagnoses, procedures, medications, lab results, imaging and clinical notes in FHIR-aligned resources.

valueChain.name: Billing & Claims Processing
valueChain.description: Translate clinical activity into charges, claims, coding (ICD/CPT/HCPCS), prior authorizations and payment posting.

valueChain.name: Clinical Quality & Safety
valueChain.description: Measure clinical outcomes, adverse events, infections, medication safety and accreditation metrics against standards.

valueChain.name: Population Health & Analytics
valueChain.description: Aggregate data across patients to identify risk cohorts, care gaps, utilization patterns and cost drivers.

valueChain.name: Personalization & Outreach
valueChain.description: Deliver patient-specific insights, reminders, care plans, telehealth and next-best-actions to improve outcomes and engagement.

starSchema.summary: FACT_HEALTHCARE_ENCOUNTER is the central fact capturing patient encounters, costs, outcomes and quality measures. It joins to patient, provider, care site, diagnosis, procedure, medication, payer and time dimensions for healthcare analytics.

facts.name: FACT_HEALTHCARE_ENCOUNTER
facts.grain: Encounter × Patient × Provider × Care Site × Diagnosis × Procedure × Payer × Time

dimensions.name: DIM_TIME

useCases.title: Population Health Risk Stratification
useCases.objective: Identify high-risk patient cohorts and prioritize outreach to reduce admissions and improve chronic disease management.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces emergency admissions and readmissions by 10-15%; improves care-gap closure rates.
useCases.kpiTarget: Risk-stratify 80% of active patients by month 6

useCases.title: Clinical Quality & Safety Dashboard
useCases.objective: Monitor quality measures, adverse events, hospital-acquired infections and medication safety in real time.
useCases.businessValue: Supports accreditation and reduces harm events by 20-30% through early detection.
useCases.kpiTarget: Quality measures available within 24 hours of encounter close

useCases.title: Revenue Cycle & Denial Management
useCases.objective: Reduce claim denials, improve coding accuracy and accelerate collections through analytics.
useCases.businessValue: Reduces denial rate by 15-25% and AR days by 20-30%.
useCases.kpiTarget: Denial rate <5% and AR days <40 by month 12

useCases.title: Sehat Sahulat Program Analytics
useCases.objective: Track utilization, cost, outcomes and fraud patterns for Pakistan's Sehat Sahulat health insurance program.
useCases.businessValue: Improves program oversight, reduces fraud and supports government reporting.
useCases.kpiTarget: Sehat Sahulat utilization and cost dashboard live by month 9

useCases.title: Patient Engagement & Next-Best-Action
useCases.objective: Personalize reminders, screenings, appointments and care plans to improve adherence and outcomes.
useCases.businessValue: Improves preventive screening rates by 20% and reduces no-shows by 15-25%.
useCases.kpiTarget: Deploy personalized outreach for 50% of eligible patients by month 12

useCases.title: Fraud, Waste & Abuse Detection
useCases.objective: Detect anomalous billing, provider behavior and claims patterns to reduce leakage.
useCases.businessValue: Recovers 2-5% of claims spend through fraud and waste prevention.
useCases.kpiTarget: Real-time anomaly scoring for 100% of claims by month 18

useCases.title: Facility Utilization & Capacity Planning
useCases.objective: Optimize bed, OR, clinic and staff utilization to reduce wait times and improve access.
useCases.businessValue: Improves occupancy and throughput; reduces ED wait times and patient leakage.
useCases.kpiTarget: Capacity planning dashboard with 7-day forecast by month 18
